notes.title: NEW DEMO FOR COUCH COOP FEST
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you for your incredible support of FUFUFU! It motivates us so much to keep adding more and more FUn content ❤️

We created FUFUFU out of a desire to rediscover the taste for couch games where we elbowed each other with our buddies, the ones on which we spent evenings in laughter back in the 2000s. So what could be more logical than to take part in the Couch Coop Fest? 😁

For the occasion, we've prepared a new demo with freshly baked content! Come and try out our new recipe, signed Potofu Studio 🍲

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025050/FUFUFU/  

Want to try out this brand-new demo with new people? [url=discord.gg/exHEUhua4v]Join our official Discord[/url] to get the latest announcements and chat with the community!

See you soon!
The Potofu team

notes.title: Ever raced against a ram and a chicken on steroids?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541525/36c63568609120d09496745674583c410bb683d5.png[/img]
For the Steam Remote Play Together festival, we're super excited to be releasing our brand new demo for free until February 19.

Here you can discover how our Roguelike works, as well as two new adventures. And let me warn you, we've gone even further into the craziness. 🤣 😱

🍲 On the menu 🍲 
🔢 🧠 Numbers that will melt your brain. 
🏃‍♀️ 💨 🐔 Racing on vitamins against runners on steroids.

👉 If you're interested in the game, sign up for our crowdfunding campaign! https://www.kisskissbankbank.com/fr/projects/fufufu
👉 You can also help us with a small wishlist on Steam.

Don't hesitate to give us feedback if you take the time to test the game 🙏 💖
